title: See overdue orders
summary: Filter overdue orders and see why they are overdue: too many days in the stage or a past due date.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Overdue only
steps.details: An order is overdue when it goes past its stage’s day limit or its due date passes before it reaches a final stage.

steps.title: Open an overdue order
steps.details: Red days mark the stage delay; the “Past due” tag marks the missed due date.

steps.title: Why it is overdue
steps.details: Shows the days in stage next to the limit (“5 days · max 3”) and, if the due date passed, how many days ago.

steps.title: Lab contact
steps.details: The lab’s phones and email to chase the job.

steps.title: Stage history
steps.details: The change is recorded with the user, the date and how long the order spent in the previous stage.
